citations.assessment: This address has the unqualified patronymic son of Rabbah and the respectful request to Rav Yosef.
The same abbreviated patronymic and form of address occur. A nearby tradition names Rabbah bar Rav Huna, and that juxtaposition does not settle the author’s distinction.
The received paragraph names Rava son of Rabbah in the group-learning derashah. The reverse name form is separately attributed in the adjoining local article.
The target article expressly records the reverse patronymic in the Ein Yaakov tradition and compares the variation.

holds.raw: והיוחסין שכח זכרו או שסבר אחד הוא ואין שני
holds.reason: Preserve the two explanations as the narrator’s hypotheses. Neither the repeated short patronymic nor the different fuller source forms prove what Yuhasin intended.

notes.text: The named two-identity explanation is Heilprin’s. The juxtaposed name forms and reverse patronymic remain visible.
